name: read_material
description: Read pages of a frozen public PDF for the current case. Page numbers start at 1. Maximum 3 pages per call. No access to other cases or private research files.

name: search_material
description: Search a frozen public PDF by keywords in the material language (Chinese or English) to locate relevant pages without reading sequentially. Use concise, space-separated keywords. Returns up to 3 page excerpts. Only current case documents are allowed.

name: select_strategy
description: Commit the single primary strategy for the forthcoming public reply. Call exactly once after preparation, before replying. Do not provide a rationale.
